method-structure-diagnostic v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides a structured diagnostic tool for assessing the completeness and coherence of Method sections in psychology research papers.
- Evaluates according to 11 core structural dimensions, strictly referencing standard checklists, rubrics, and top-journal exemplars.
- Outputs a detailed, fixed-format report with scoring breakdown, core issues, targeted improvements, and sample excerpts from exemplary papers.
- Ensures consistent, objective scoring with transparent justification, and enforces tight boundaries regarding scope and collaboration with other evaluation skills.
- Integrated logic for exemplar usage; supports actionable, prioritized revision recommendations.
